name: Clay
description: Chalky handmade clay and painted plaster miniature
form: Soft thick rounded forms, slightly uneven molded edges, shallow three-quarter view
finish: Fine mottled sponge texture, matte surface, diffuse shadows, almost no specular shine
palette: Pale pistachio and lime main forms, seafoam or turquoise secondary parts, tiny orange-gold details

name: Flare
description: Flat vector illustration with restrained faux depth
form: Compact app-icon silhouette built from a few crisp geometric planes, mild three-quarter view
finish: Hard-edged light and dark color blocks, one narrow pale highlight, solid navy side faces; no reflective material
palette: Bright spring green dominates; deep navy defines depth; cyan and pale blue mark secondary details; yellow-orange only as a small accent

name: Zing
form: Recognizable school or study object, thin black outer and inner contours, white open planes, gentle three-quarter tilt
finish: Flat untextured fills, small simple side faces, almost no shadow
palette: Mostly white with periwinkle blue side planes; small lemon-yellow and bubblegum-pink details

name: Gloss
form: Chunky rounded collectible object with thick gold framing and inset blue panels, centered three-quarter view
finish: Bright hard-edged gleams, bevels, glassy gem inserts, rich local contrast
palette: Warm amber and gold dominate edges; electric cyan and royal blue fill insets; tiny emerald accents

name: Mist
description: Airy modern digital icon with soft volume
form: Very simple rounded UI object with few parts, mostly frontal with subtle three-quarter depth
finish: Smooth pale-blue-to-cobalt shading, milky white top-left glow, soft edge highlights and no dark stroke
palette: Powder blue and white dominate; coral red is a tiny functional accent

name: Pebble
form: Sturdy rounded everyday object with simple proportions, shallow three-quarter view
finish: Mostly flat blue fills, restrained smooth shading, short dark-blue side face, tiny glints
palette: Medium cornflower or cobalt blue dominates, bright yellow for large functional parts, orange for tiny details, navy for holes and shadows

name: Drift
form: Rounded simplified consumer object, visible functional feature, three-quarter view
finish: Smooth molded satin surface, broad gentle value shifts, sparse narrow highlights, no black stroke
palette: Vivid emerald or teal-green main body, sunny yellow hardware, cyan secondary panel, navy only inside recesses

name: Ink
form: Single instantly readable object drawn with confidently irregular medium black lines, nearly frontal
finish: White interiors, selective solid-black side or cavity, a few short motion ticks; little to no hatching
palette: Black ink only on white

name: Cardboard
form: Folded kraft-paper construction with real-looking seams, edge thickness, straps, tabs, and cutouts, three-quarter view
finish: Fine corrugated fiber and paper grain, matte edges, soft tabletop lighting
palette: Warm tan kraft dominates; muted indigo-blue and teal paper panels; tiny coral or golden fasteners

name: Linepop
form: Mostly white object described by thin even near-black contours and clean inner construction lines, slight three-quarter view
finish: Little to no shaded fill, extremely restrained pale-blue side plane, tiny crisp highlight
palette: White dominates; neon lime focal marks and smaller yellow marks; pale blue for depth; near-black for hairline outlines

name: Glide
description: Ultra-clean flat vector with gentle dimensional cutouts
form: Simplified lifestyle object built from a few broad rounded planes, mild three-quarter view
finish: No drawn outlines or texture; at most a slightly darker green side plane and one minimal highlight
palette: Deep emerald green dominates; saturated golden yellow on key parts; tiny violet and cream accents

name: Nimble
form: Simple commerce or utility object with accurate functional parts, shallow three-quarter view
finish: Thin consistent black outlines, white broad faces, restrained light-blue side shade, flat fills
palette: White dominates; strong royal blue areas; small vivid yellow functional accents; black contours

name: Jot
form: Single everyday object with thin slightly imperfect black contours, mostly front or mild three-quarter view
finish: Open white interiors, few faint cool-gray shadow strokes, no dense hatch
palette: White and black dominate; buttery pale yellow fills only one or two simple sections

name: Riso
form: Chunky editorial object made from overlapping graphic print plates, shallow three-quarter view
finish: Visible halftone dots and slight ink offset, paper grain, hard print edges, no volumetric shine
palette: Electric cobalt blue, acid yellow, aqua mint, lavender, small coral-red offset; cream-paper gaps

name: Marker
form: Object simplified to a strong contour and few interior marks, near-front view
finish: Thick slightly wobbly deep forest-green outline, flat marker-filled shapes with tiny uneven edges, almost no shadow
palette: Bubblegum pink and green dominate, with lemon yellow and pale aqua fills

name: Glass
form: Simple object with rounded clear walls and readable silhouette, three-quarter view
finish: Very pale frosted cyan body, layered transparency, narrow iridescent cyan edge, faint glow rather than dark contrast
palette: Icy cyan and powder blue dominate; tiny warm coral, peach, or lemon accents; large white luminous gaps

name: Watercolor
form: Object with realistic simplified structure, mostly three-quarter view
finish: Visible uneven pigment wash, granulation and dry-paper flecks, soft edges within a clear silhouette
palette: Dusty medium blue dominates, warm ochre-yellow on key parts, cream-paper highlights

name: Yarn
form: Recognizable cozy object built from thick stitched pieces and sewn-on small details, three-quarter view
finish: Individual yarn loops and cable-knit ridges visible throughout, soft wool fibers, gentle warm lighting
palette: Muted sage green, oatmeal cream, chestnut brown, and tiny burnt-orange stitches

name: Sketchy
form: Object with chunky slightly irregular black contour, shallow three-quarter view
finish: Solid flat fills, tiny white shine marks, an occasional second interior line; no texture
palette: Bright turquoise-cyan main fill, coral pink secondary, vivid blue tertiary, black outline

name: Pulse
description: Geometric flat vector with offset depth
form: Office or utility object assembled from broad straight-edged color panels, mostly frontal
finish: Matte solid fill, no contour stroke, one dark navy offset side face, zero texture
palette: Indigo-periwinkle dominates, dusty sage green secondary, coral-orange and mustard-yellow small panels, deep navy depth

name: Candypop
form: Inflated sweets or playful fantasy object made of fat rounded pieces, centered three-quarter view
finish: Hard white reflections, glassy candy coating, thick luminous rims, occasional tiny sparkle
palette: Hot magenta and candy pink, electric cyan and royal blue, vivid violet, bright yellow highlights

name: Charcoal
form: Familiar household object with believable form and slightly uneven dark contours, three-quarter view
finish: Dense visible pencil strokes following form, gray-blue hatching, soft paper-grain shadows
palette: Slate and denim blue-gray dominate, cream highlights, small dusty salmon or pale gold accents

name: Ceramic
form: Rounded molded home-decor form with raised relief, scalloped or fluted edges, centered three-quarter view
finish: Soft porcelain glaze with small smooth specular highlights, hand-shaped irregularity, delicate inset ornament
palette: Blush pink dominates, pale aqua or mint inset parts, lavender, cream, and tiny gold details

name: Fuzzy
form: Compact soft object with a puffy but precise silhouette, near-front view
finish: Dense velvety microfibers over every surface, rounded seams and appliqued details, soft diffuse light
palette: Hot pink main body, lavender secondary, baby-blue panels, tiny peach details

name: Colorcut
form: One compact object reduced to a few irregular overlapping silhouettes, near-front view, no perspective grid
finish: Mostly flat opaque fills with small soft gradient transitions at overlaps, rounded corners, no stroke outline or cast shadow
palette: Vivid cobalt blue, leaf green, vermilion red, bubblegum pink, sunny orange, and pale lime chosen as two or three dominant hues per icon

name: Hologram
form: Small floating pictogram built from five to seven broad beveled geometric facets, subtle three-quarter tilt and faint horizontal ground shadow
finish: Opalescent cyan-violet-pink-gold color transitions on select facets, clean narrow edge lights, sparse sparkles; icon-like rather than physically metallic
palette: Powder cyan and lavender dominate, with peach pink, golden yellow and mint reflections against a very pale aqua field

name: Nightfall
form: One expressive subject with at most one or two small related props, dynamic tilt or float, rounded silhouette on a deep slate field
finish: Soft painted gradients on simplified matte beveled planes, mild grain, small bright highlights and occasional motion/cloud/star accents
palette: Coral peach, sky blue, lime green, sunflower yellow and warm orange against dark blue-charcoal #2B424A

name: Storyworld
form: Architectural mini-scene on a square or diamond plinth, one strong hero object, at most two supporting pieces and a clear isometric grid
finish: Hard vector facets plus limited blue-violet-coral-yellow gradients on selected faces, deep midnight portal interiors with tiny stars, sharply defined platform shadows
palette: Cobalt blue and violet structures, warm lemon-yellow planes, coral-pink and mint accents, near-black navy portals on a warm white field
